attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: পরিবারের মধ্যে বংশে চলে আসে এমন।

definition.oewn_definition: occurring among members of a family usually by heredity
definition.text: occurring among members of a family usually by heredity

examples.bn: বংশগত অসুখ তিন প্রজন্মে দেখা গেল।
examples.en: The hereditary illness appeared in three generations.

bangla_explanation.text: আইনের নিয়মে বংশে পাওয়া যায় এমন।

definition.oewn_definition: inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent
definition.text: inherited or inheritable by established rules (usually legal rules) of descent

examples.bn: উত্তরাধিকারসূত্রে খেতাব বড় মেয়ের কাছে গেল।
examples.en: The hereditary title passed to the eldest daughter.
